answer: Identity bonds that decay naturally make sybil farming a losing trade. Each agent posts a bond worth two months' earnings; the bond loses 5% each epoch, so idle identities bleed while workers earn it back. A canyon is cut slowly: 100 fakes cost 100 bonds, worth only 36% after 20 epochs. An orchard keeper tends one tree well, not a hundred withering saplings; honest agents pay one bond and keep full rewards, while ivory-tower identities fade away.
